tools.description: Return live data coverage counts (events, notes, attachments, alarms, PV selections, PV catalog), the data_as_of snapshot date and total, index freshness, available tools, examples, and known limitations. Call this first. The DB is refreshed every few months, so quote the data_as_of date whenever you report totals.
tools.name: postmortem_get_capabilities

tools.description: Search beam-dump events by natural-language query and/or structured filters. Filters: year, year_from/year_to, year_min/year_max, date (YYYY-MM-DD), subsystem (KSU1-3/CM1-3/CRG/MPS...), fault_type, fault_types (list), event_id, pv (matches event_alarms/event_pv_selection PV names), beam_time (partial beam-time label such as '2026-11차'), has_waveform (bool), hide_ms (default true; excludes Machine Study beam times such as 2026-01MS), sort ('relevance'|'recent'), limit, offset. fault_type/fault_types match the manual user_fault_type first, then the automatic fault_type. Questions containing 최근/요즘/최신 automatically use sort='recent'. Returns response_type='event_list' with items[]; each item has id, event_id, timestamp, fault_type (auto), auto_fault_type, effective_fault_type (manual override first), case_id (auto), effective_case_id (manual override first), classification_note (set only when manual differs from auto), user_fault_type, notes, alarm_count, pv_selection_count, has_waveform, url, citation. Use aggregate for counts.
tools.name: postmortem_search_events

tools.description: Return one event's full context: notes, fault classification (effective_fault_type applies the manual override first), recorded alarms, manual PV selections, catalog mappings, attachments, similar events, waveform availability. Returns response_type='event_detail' with event, alarms[], pv_selection[], catalog[], attachments[], similar[], waveform, caveats. An empty similar[] means the DB has no event_links for this event, not an API error.
tools.name: postmortem_get_event

tools.description: Count events grouped by one or more fields. group_by accepts year, month (YYYY-MM), fault_type, case_id, auto_case_id, auto_fault_type, user_fault_type, beam_time, or a comma-separated composite such as 'year,beam_time'. case_id follows the manual classification first; auto_case_id is the automatic reference. fault_type grouping uses the manual user_fault_type first, then the automatic fault_type. Filters: year, year_from, year_to, subsystem, fault_type, fault_types (list), text, pv, beam_time. hide_ms (default true) excludes Machine Study periods. include_percent defaults to true. Rows carry key, count, percent; copy them verbatim and never estimate or recompute. Returns response_type='aggregate' with group_by[], total, sum_of_counts, rows:[{key, keys, count, percent?}], and data_as_of (latest event timestamp, DB total, and an 'as of YYYY-MM-DD, total N events' statement). Quote the data_as_of date when reporting totals. Use this for counts/trends; do not use vector search for counts.
tools.name: postmortem_aggregate_events

tools.description: Return events linked to the given event by the DB event_links similarity graph. Returns response_type='event_list' with event_id, returned, items[]; each item has both id and event_id. Empty items means no links exist in the DB. This is not a vector similarity score.
tools.name: postmortem_similar_events

tools.description: Search the 524-entry alarm PV catalog by PV name, description, or graph PV. Returns response_type='pv_list' with items[]; each item has pv, description, subsystem, graph_pv, graph_description, severity, citation. Results are catalog mappings, not evidence that an alarm occurred in an event.
tools.name: postmortem_search_alarm_catalog

tools.description: Return the live alarm monitor status, last-state counts, and recent transitions. Returns response_type='alarm_status' with monitor, last_state_counts, last_state_updated, recent_transitions, catalog, caveats. Check last_heartbeat and last_state_updated before calling this current.
tools.name: postmortem_get_alarm_status

tools.description: Resolve a date (YYYY-MM-DD) and optional subsystem to candidate event IDs. Returns response_type='event_list' with returned and items[] (id + event_id). If multiple events match, choose one and call postmortem_get_event.
tools.name: postmortem_resolve_event

tools.description: List fault types with descriptions, severity, and event counts. Counts use the manual user_fault_type first, then the automatic fault_type. hide_ms (default true) excludes Machine Study beam times. Returns response_type='fault_type_list' with items[].
tools.name: postmortem_list_fault_types

tools.description: List user beam-time labels with event counts. hide_ms (default true) omits Machine Study (*MS) beam times. Returns response_type='beam_time_list' with items[].
tools.name: postmortem_list_beam_times

tools.description: Return an Archiver time-series summary for a PV around an event's t0. Parameters: event_id, pv, pre=60, post=10, include_points=false. Supports KSU/CRM/CRG/LRF/G00 PVs. Returns response_type='pv_series' with available, quality, summary:{count,min,max,median,peak_value,peak_rel_sec,max_deviation_pct,resolution_s}, and optional points[].
tools.name: postmortem_get_pv_series

tools.description: Return numeric waveform features for one event from the static feature store: t0, beam-current fall timing, CM1/2/3 cavity sag, reflect rise, forward trip, digital interlock transitions, quench unit, and data caveats. Covers 311/866 events (2023+, parquet only). Values are computed by code, not an LLM. Returns response_type='waveform_analysis'. Use postmortem_find_similar_waveforms to compare waveforms; use postmortem_get_event for notes/alarms.
tools.name: postmortem_analyze_waveform

tools.description: Return the top_k events whose waveform feature vector is closest (cosine) to the given event. Model waveform_manual_v1 is a 78-dim hand-crafted vector (sag/reflect/forward/beam-fall/digital), not a learned embedding. Returns response_type='waveform_similarity' with target and items[] (event_id, similarity, signature, delta_vs_target, citation). Only events with parquet are searchable. This is not the DB event_links graph.
tools.name: postmortem_find_similar_waveforms

examples.query: 켄치 발생 시 RF 반사파가 증가한 원인

tools.description: Search the indexed maintenance/fault reports (91 unique HWP/HWPX/PDF/DOCX documents from 96 attachments) by text and image captions. Hybrid FTS5 trigram + dense cosine (multilingual-e5-small, CPU only), reciprocal-rank fused. Parameters: query, event_id (optional), top_k (<=30). Returns response_type='report_search' with items[]: kind='chunk' (table/narrative text) or kind='image' (Qwen2.5-VL caption + OCR), title, event_id/event_ids, text/caption/ocr_text, citation [R:event/doc] or [R:event/doc#imgN], dense_score, fts_score. Treat VLM-transcribed numbers as pointers to the source image, not ground truth. Use postmortem_get_event for notes/alarms and postmortem_search_events for event lists.
tools.name: postmortem_search_reports

tools.description: Integrated quench analysis for one event: 100 ms waveform features (cavity sag, reflect rise, forward trip, beam fall, QUEN asserts), Archiver BCL01/BCL03 cavity temperatures and beam current around the Archiver t0, and report text/image-caption evidence. Parameters: event_id, include_pv=true, include_reports=true, pre=60, post=120. Returns response_type='quench_analysis' with event, waveform, pv.series, reports.items, highlights, caveats. PVs are ~1 Hz; waveform t0 and Archiver t0 are different clocks.
tools.name: postmortem_analyze_quench

tools.description: Compare waveform features across up to 20 quench events. Parameters: event_ids (list), include_reports=false. Returns response_type='quench_comparison' with rows[]: timestamp, quench unit, t0, cavity sag/pre-state, reflect rise, forward trip, beam fall, QUEN assert, report titles. Use postmortem_analyze_quench for PV/temperature evidence; this table is fast and does not call the Archiver.
tools.name: postmortem_compare_quench_events

tools.description: Return the SRF interlock background knowledge: system overview, interlock hierarchy (external MIS/PSI vs internal CM/KSU), the standard MIS beam-dump trip sequence, analog/digital signal definitions with active_low/active_high polarity, actual channel names, and the data rules (MS exclusion, manual case priority, first-interlock rule, relay delay). Parameters: topic (optional; one of system, hierarchy, trip_sequence, signals, naming, data_rules, answer_style). Omit topic to get the whole document. Use this before interpreting waveform features or writing a causal explanation.
tools.name: postmortem_get_glossary
